description: The power of cooperation; Groups work together, trading goods and ideas, helping each other, protecting each other, etc. When cooperating societies can accomplish great things, or bring down great foes, they can be good or bad, fast or slow, ongoing or temporary.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical cooperation; magical alliances, divine cooperation, etc.
